package protocoldef

//roost:proto package=game.protocol go_package=GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb;pb

type PlayRequest struct {
	Seq         uint64 `pb:"1"`
	Kind        string `pb:"2"`
	Level       int64  `pb:"3"`
	Destination int64  `pb:"4"`
}
type PlayResponse struct {
	Code int32  `pb:"1"`
	Seq  uint64 `pb:"2"`
}
type PlayProtocol interface {
	//roost:msg id=15011 tags=local
	Play(PlayRequest) PlayResponse
}
